rows.title: Each set opens only its own notifications, and asks the answers the data specification gives it
rows.detail: Germinal products is a sibling set of live animals in the animals frontend, and both keep their notifications in the one animals backend, so a notification must only ever be worked in the set that owns it. Each set's entry checks the category the set recorded when it created the draft and refuses the other set's notifications. A notification stored before the germinal set existed has no category and is treated as live animals, so it keeps working in the live-animals set with no data migration. The same row settles which answers the germinal set asks: the notification data specification covers both sets on one page and marks the exceptions, so every answer it sets out is asked in both sets unless it is marked for one, and where both sets ask an answer but allow different values each set offers its own list.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening a germinal products notification through a live animals page shows the page not found page and changes nothing on the notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, -p1-031; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-094)

Opening a live animals notification through a germinal products page shows the page not found page and changes nothing on the notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, -p1-031)

A notification whose record holds no category opens, saves and submits in the live animals set, and opening it through a germinal products page shows the page not found page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, -p1-030, -p1-031; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-097)

Where the notification data specification marks an answer as applying to the animals journey alone, the germinal products page copied from that live animals page does not ask it; every other answer it asks is the one its live animals twin asks. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-003, -p1-004; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-007)
Where both sets ask an answer whose permitted values differ between them, each set's page offers that set's own list of values. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-005)
rows.notes: Two slices: the cross-set guard (req-1901) and the rule deciding which answers each set asks (req-2210). Both are this area's share of existing row inc-176, which already holds them; the combiner keeps inc-176's id, theme germinal-products, repos (backend, frontend, tests), gate and dependsOn, and merges these criteria with the other areas' there, taking out any criterion another area states the same way. The guard reads the category the backend stores and returns on the read, which the notification-record area's requirements in inc-176 build, so the guard is not observable apart from them. The cross-set check is built at the set mount, in the germinal set and the router the germinal-products theme already owns, so the live-animals flow folder the split-off journey-foundation theme owns is not edited; if the plan finds the live-animals entry guard itself must change, that change belongs on the journey-foundation branch and this row consumes it, as inc-176's notes already say. Re-distil 27 November: neither requirement changed in substance.

rows.title: The germinal journey follows the live animals journey, without the additional details, CPH number and permanent address steps
rows.detail: The germinal products set is built from copies of the live animals pages, taken once this programme has finished changing them, so a trader who has used one set recognises the other: the same pages under the same slugs beneath the germinal mount, the same status strip and the same journey buttons. Three live animals steps never apply, because the notification data specification marks them for the animals journey alone: additional details, CPH number and permanent address. So the germinal set has no page for any of them, its overview has no 'Additional details' task and its 'Consignment addresses' page has no CPH number or permanent address row. What the consignment is certified for has only one answer, so the draft is created holding 'Germinal products' and no page asks it. A germinal notification's strip shows a GBN-AG reference, like a live animals one.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal products notification's journey pages are reached at /germinal-products/notifications/<reference>/<slug>, under the same slugs the live animals set uses. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-007, -p1-009, -p1-010; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-007)

Opening the additional details, CPH number or permanent address page of a germinal products notification shows the page not found page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016, -p1-017, -p1-018; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p1-056)

A germinal products notification's overview shows the same tasks, in the same sections and the same order, as a live animals notification's overview, except that it holds no 'Additional details' task. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p10-143)

A germinal products notification's 'Consignment addresses' page shows the consignment party rows alone, with no CPH number row and no permanent address row. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, -p1-018; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p10-144)

When identification applies to a germinal products notification, the page after it in the opening run is arrival details. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016, -p1-017, -p1-018; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p1-123; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p10-145)

Every germinal products journey page shows the status strip with the notification's status and a reference of the form GBN-AG-<two-digit year>-<six characters>. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-027, -p1-086)

Every germinal products journey page ends with the same journey buttons, in the same order and with the same labels, as the live animals page it is copied from. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011, -p1-014; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p10-146)

A germinal products draft is created holding 'Germinal products' as what the consignment is certified for, no germinal page asks it, and the germinal review shows 'Certified for' reading 'Germinal products' with no Change link. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-019, -p1-020; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p10-147)
The high-risk plants frontend has no germinal set and no germinal page: its journey and its pages are unchanged. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-056)
rows.notes: One slice (req-1898), this area's share of existing row inc-182, which already holds it; the combiner keeps inc-182's id, theme germinal-products, repos and dependsOn and merges these criteria with the other areas' there, stating each once. c-274 (ruled by precedence): every set keeps the real path shape under its own base path, so no criterion states the prototype's flat paths. The certified-for criterion repeats inc-182's own and is stated once there. The germinal set's copies of the overview, check answers, declaration and confirmation come from the rows inc-182 already depends on. Re-distil 27 November: the statement did not change in substance; the 27 November ruling's claims on the germinal list and manage notifications do not reach these pages.

rows.title: End-to-end proof: a germinal products notification for bovine semen, from create to submitted
rows.detail: The germinal products set is proven whole, not page by page: one walk takes a bovine semen consignment from creating the notification to submitting it, so a change to any germinal page that breaks the journey is caught. The walk lives in the test suite's existing animals project, beside the live animals journey walks, because germinal products is a sibling set in the same frontend rather than a new service.
acceptanceCriteria: A spec in the test suite's existing animals project, under tests/animals/e2e/germinal-products, walks a germinal products notification for bovine semen from create to submitted: the Netherlands as the country of origin, a net weight and a number of packages, Frozen, Internal market for Breeding, donor identification entered once for the species, Port of Dover by Road with transit through Belgium, and a consignee chosen on the 'Consignment addresses' page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-062, -p1-063)
Before declaring, that walk checks the germinal review page shows each answer it gave. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-110)
The walk runs in the animals project's existing browser configuration, with no new test project added. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-062, -p1-063)
rows.notes: One slice (req-1899), this area's share of existing row inc-184, which already holds it alone; the combiner keeps inc-184's id, theme germinal-products, repos and dependsOn (inc-182, inc-183, inc-141, inc-172). Tests only, like the live animals end-to-end proof rows: every behaviour the walk exercises is built by the germinal rows it depends on, so its acceptance is observable once it lands, locally and in CI. The walk asserts no button destination. Re-distil 27 November: the statement did not change.
